owner_authorization: Owner standing authorization is limited to B8.2 E0/no-data decision-contract completion; no data, activation, execution, report, or research decision is authorized.
research_question: On matched pre-2016 U8-common weekly decision dates, does U8 versus U4 reduce preregistered dependency and concentration, increase independent trend opportunity, and survive locked-cost and deterministic robustness controls, without any profitability claim?

universes.dates: Exactly U8-common eligible weekly decision dates; no pairwise, complete-case, post-result, or validation date selection.

primary_sizing.step_1: u[i,t] = q[i,t] with no division by volatility.
primary_sizing.q_over_volatility_sensitivity: One frozen q/volatility sensitivity is non-claim-eligible and cannot choose any conclusion; L-3 remains unresolved.

inherited_controls.anti_pseudoreplication: One weekly paired portfolio observation; never assets, sleeves, correlations, days, trades, or overlapping realized windows.
inherited_controls.data_integrity: Freeze L1 legal inceptions, sleeves, regions, identifiers, no pre-inception backfill, corporate-action/currency/cost semantics, and fixed-universe limits.
inherited_controls.survivorship: Live ETF proxies do not prove survivorship-free history; missing point-in-time or delisted alternatives remain scope restrictions.
inherited_controls.search_inventory: One U4/U8 primary q comparison and at most one frozen non-claim-eligible q/volatility sensitivity; no post-result universe/date/filter selection or unlogged search.
inherited_controls.claim_limits: No L-3 inverse-volatility pass proof, no U1 primary inference, no breadth/profitability/edge/E1/E2/E3/deployment claim from this E0 gate.

component_risk.formula: rc_i = w_i * (Sigma w)_i; p_i = abs(rc_i) / sum_j abs(rc_j); HHI = sum_i p_i^2.
component_risk.covariance: Inherited L1 60-session EWMA covariance with deterministic PSD clipping.
component_risk.cash: Cash is excluded from asset HHI and reported separately.
component_risk.non_evaluable: Missing/nonfinite input or zero/nonfinite denominator makes the whole paired week non-evaluable.

realized_hhi_delta.formula: Fixed execution-close weights and actual total-return rows t+1 through t+20 only; sample covariance is PSD-clipped then component risk is recomputed; never feed realized covariance into sizing.

top_dependency_delta.formula: market_share=max_i p_i; macro_sleeve_share=sum p_i in fixed sleeves; top_dependency=max(market_share, macro_sleeve_share); delta=U4-U8.

n_eff_delta.formula: Use continuous signed q for every asset on exactly trailing 52 common eligible weekly decision dates ending at t; every series complete/nonconstant; Pearson correlation, negative-eigenvalue clipping, clipped mass, N_eff=(sum lambda)^2/sum(lambda^2), delta=U8-U4; mean absolute off-diagonal correlation is diagnostic only.

statistics.actual_recalculation: For each metric and each plan separately recompute sample SD, lags 1-5, dependence inflation, HAC/Newey-West interval, falsify MinTRL, validation-zero MinTRL, and validation-minimum-useful MinTRL; no metric may fund another.

robustness_and_side_effects.best_market: Greatest U8 cumulative net PnL contribution after exact asset-attributed locked costs; ties inherited order; remove from U8/U4, renormalize component shares without rerun/reselection, same weeks, mean HHI delta >=0.025 and >=50% original; zero denominator/nonpositive original is non-evaluable.
robustness_and_side_effects.best_episode: Inherited per-asset q episode rule; select greatest net-PnL contribution after costs, ties asset order then earliest start; remove its paired weeks from both branches, retain actual primary MinTRL, mean HHI delta >=0.025 and >=50% original; no alternative search.
robustness_and_side_effects.side_effects: On identical paired dates: turnover_intensity=sum one-way turnover/sum pre-trade gross exposure; cost_intensity=sum locked booked costs/sum pre-trade gross exposure; each relative increase (U8-U4)/U4 <=0.20, zero/nonfinite comparator non-evaluable; inherited L3 cap/cash/scale-down frequency delta <=10pp.

regime_matrix.funding: Each inferential bucket independently meets its metric actual MinTRL; no pooling; underfunded bucket is descriptive and blocks its E2 scope.

decision_contract.scope_restricted: If any mandatory metric, deterministic constraint, or required E1 input is non-evaluable OR any mandatory metric is below its falsify actual MinTRL, return scope_restricted before testing breaches.
decision_contract.falsified_E1_only: Only if scope_restricted is false and at least one mandatory metric one-sided 95% UCB is strictly below useful threshold OR a deterministic full-sample constraint breaches; mechanism autopsy required and validation sealed.
decision_contract.not_falsified_not_validated_E1: Only if the prior predicates are false; validation remains sealed.
decision_contract.validation_scope_restricted: Future separate stage: any mandatory validation plan/regime/constraint non-evaluable or underfunded returns scope_restricted.
decision_contract.validation_candidate: Future separate stage only after validation_scope_restricted false, every mandatory 95% LCB strictly exceeds useful threshold, all constraints pass, and integrity/adversarial review pass; B8.2 grants no E2.
decision_contract.equality: UCB equal threshold is not falsification; LCB equal threshold is not validation candidate; precedence makes outcomes exhaustive and mutually exclusive.

hard_stops: No data/container/path inspection beyond named methodology sources and committed controls.
No market, return, signal, position, covariance, regime, cost, or PnL computation or backtest.
No validation, provider/network, credentials, broker, paid, paper-trade, or real-money action.
No L-4 activation, execution runner, report, ledger, or B8.3.
No L-3 closure weakening or inverse-volatility pass claim.
